title: Aromatic Egyptian Shrimp Pilaf
description: A pungent and kid-friendly Egyptian dish featuring shrimp, with a cheese-pull and low-glycemic ingredients, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the basmati rice and stir to combine with the shrimp and spices.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 15 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in the crumbled feta cheese.
